final:
`public/models/toycar.glb` is now 1.03 MB, down from 5.42 MB. In the CLI's headless-Chromium test, load time on 4G dropped from about 5.1 s to 1.25 s. I haven't run the viewer in a browser.

- **Quality:** the CLI's fidelity score is 0.982. Its guideline for no visible quality loss is 0.9 or higher.
- **Textures:** all eight are now WebP at their original sizes. Color maps are at quality 75, and normal, metal/rough and occlusion maps are at quality 85.
- **Geometry:** meshopt compression at the high level, with the same 108,936 triangles.
- **`src/viewer.js`:** the file needs the meshopt decoder (about 6 KB gzipped), so I imported `MeshoptDecoder` and added `loader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder)`. The decoder is also needed for the other models if you optimize them the same way. I only changed the toy car.

I also started a KTX2 texture variant but didn't wait for it. It would need an extra decoder in the viewer, and the WebP result is already close to what this model can reach.

The original is still at `assets/toycar.glb`.
bash_cmds: node-assets --help; ls -la assets public/models src; cat src/viewer.js
node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t1.glb --geometry meshopt --force && node-assets inspect /tmp/t1.glb --against assets/toycar.glb --network 4g
node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t2.glb --force && node-assets inspect /tmp/t2.glb --against assets/toycar.glb --network 4g

for q in 75; do node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t3.glb --geometry meshopt --meshopt-level high --texture-quality $q --texture-data-quality 85 --force >/dev/null && node-assets inspect /tmp/t3.glb --against assets/toycar.glb --network 4g | grep -E "bytes|textures|fidelity|load_s"; done
node-assets optimize assets/toycar.glb -o /tmp/t4.glb --geometry meshopt --texture-format ktx2 --force >/dev/null && node-assets inspect /tmp/t4.glb --against assets/toycar.glb --network 4g | grep -E "bytes|textures|fidelity|load_s|decoders"

cp /tmp/t3.glb public/models/toycar.glb && python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { MeshoptDecoder } from 'three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js';\nimport { OrbitControls",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();\n","const loader = new GLTFLoader();\nloader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
grep -n -i meshopt src/viewer.js; ls -l public/models/toycar.glb
